rules.text: It can be used on many types of structures or elements for cementitious, metallic and epoxy resin binder substrates
rules.heading: DESCRIPTION

rules.text: Systems Standard Three Coat System: (DFT: from 600um - 800um) Primer: Sikafloor 160 or 161 + 1st Coat: Sikagard®-63 N + 2nd Coat : Sikagard®-63 N . Fibreglass Laminate System: (DFT: from 1000um - 1200um) Subject to Glass thickness Primer : Sikafloor 160, Fibreglass, Sikafloor 160 + 1st Coat: Sikagard®-63 N + 2nd Coat : Sikagard®-63 N . Sikagard EpoCem 720 System: (DFT: 1200um +) Subject to thickness of SikaGard EpoCem 720: Typically used on High Wear, Damaged or High moisture content substrate applications: SikaGard EpoCem 720 + 1st Coat: Sikagard®-63 N + 2nd Coat : Sikagard®- 63 N . Please refer to individual Product Data Sheets and consult the Sika Technical Department for specific Consumption Priming and Coverage Information pertaining to project requirements: Please see Important Considerations section at the bottom of this PDS
rules.heading: SYSTEM INFORMATION

rules.text: Do not apply Sikagard®-63 N on moist substrates.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Do not use to produce glass fibre reinforced linings.
rules.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

rules.text: Products must be cured before applying Sikagard®-63 N. Steel / aluminium Surfaces must be prepared mechanically using suitable abrasive blast cleaning, grinding, rotating wire brush or other suitable equipment to achieve a bright metal finish
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

rules.text: Reference must be made to the preparation levels in the following standards if compliance is required: ISO EN 12944-4: level Sa 2 ½ NACE International Standard: SSPC-SP 10 “near white metal blast cleaned” EN 14879, part 1 Apply a suitable compatible primer on the prepared steel as soon as possible to prevent oxide development
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

rules.text: Contact Sika Technical Services for additional Epoxy resin-based products Surfaces must be prepared by abrading using suitable equipment
rules.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
